picks.name: Dwarde
picks.source_note: Up Ya Archives already seeded. New artist discovery -- his label debut.
picks.bio: "Energy Exchange" (Up Ya Archives, cat. UYA014) is a four-track EP from Dinn Warde, aka Dwarde -- a Darlington-born, London-based jungle producer and a key figure in the contemporary jungle/breakbeat revival, with two jungle cuts and two brighter, vocal-led hardcore tracks.
picks.why_listen: Big-vocal jungle and hardcore from one of the revival scene's most distinctive voices -- good for an energetic, nostalgic-leaning stretch of a set.

picks.name: DJ Die
picks.source_note: GutterFunk already seeded (previously picked for "Rock Steady" in August). This is a new, distinct single.
picks.bio: "Once Upon A Time" (November 6, 2026, GutterFunk) is a new single from Bristol drum & bass legend DJ Die (Daniel Kausman) -- co-founder of Full Cycle Recordings and a core member of Reprazent -- a nostalgic ode to the cassette-tape era of the jungle underground.
picks.why_listen: Warm, nostalgic jungle from a genre veteran -- a good rolling, reflective moment in a drum & bass-leaning set.
